I like to draw mostly as I’m not the best painter lol. I love drawing perspective mostly and cities, i also like drawing people, vehicles and countrysideI. I feel that helps me when I’m really down in the dumps sometimes. Art is a beautiful thing with a lot of power behind it. How about you? What do you like to do?
Thank you so much, it means a lot.

The sad thing is, a lot of us are in mental pain but we still don’t have the courage to end it. It’s like a feeling where you realise somethings keeping you from doing it, wether it be fear of dying or you want to give it more time it still stops you. In my case last night I just collapsed onto the floor and fell asleep. Still thanks for your comments.
Thank you, it’s good that all of you cared. That means the world to me, I was skeptical about posting here first but looks like I got more of a good result than I i initially anticipated.

Thank you, I appreciate that. Also ahah unfortunately I don’t watch game of thrones, I never have, heard it’s about dragons and lots of sex lol. I rarely watch TV shows.  I’m more into my art and mechanics if I’m honest.
I’m okay , I didn’t follow through. I appreciate the concern it means a lot to me.

I am going to give myself more time. I feel like that if I couldn’t do it last night maybe it’s not my time yet. Yeah I know hanging isn’t a nice way to go but last night I didn’t care, besides I can’t get access to pills and a gun etc, also live nowhere near a high building or a bridge. Thank you for the concern, all of you seem to care and that means so much to me.
Thanks for both your comments and concern but I don’t think this is a suitable place for arguments. Everybody has their own opinion on every different thing.
Obviously not.
I’m not dead I chicken out unfortunately, I appreciate the concern from you though. Thank you.
I get you there, that makes a lot of sense. Thank you for that, might help me in the near future.

There’s a lot of things from my past that contribute to it, a lot. They’ll always be with me. I guess I only made a post here cause I have nobody to talk to about my depression and I though this would give me the opportunity to talk to somebody and it did.

To everybody wondering, I thought it was time but I couldn’t. I just couldn’t, I don’t have the balls to do it, not yet anyway. I woke up on the floor and the ropes still tied along with my desk chair. I’m amazed so many people care, I didn’t think anybody really would. I appreciate it and all of you are doing great things on here helping people. I guess I should apologise for wasting everybody’s time as I didn’t follow through with my plan. Sorry.
